title: Multilingual Political Views of Large Language Models: Identification and Steering
reasoning: The paper utilizes the Political Compass Test (PCT) as its core evaluation instrument. The PCT consists of 62 propositions that include specific domains for 'religion' (5 propositions), 'personal social values' (18 propositions), and 'wider society' (12 propositions), thereby directly benchmarking the models' stances on religious, moral, and ethical issues as part of their broader ideological assessment.
